sections.title: Talent Advisory & GCC
sections.subtitle: Establish scalable Global Capability Centres — from strategy and set-up to build-operate-transfer — with specialist talent and managed teams.

sections.heading: Technology advisory and GCCs to *scale with confidence*
sections.body:
Bring technology roadmaps, architecture and assessments together with the people and delivery models to put them into practice. A Global Capability Centre (GCC) is an organisational capability that combines teams, tooling and governance for sustained delivery.

Choose specialists embedded in your team, a managed delivery pod or a GCC built and operated for transfer. [Discuss your required capability and location constraints](#get-in-touch).

sections.heading: What we deliver
sections.description: Choose the specialist service that fits your next decision.

items.title: Technology advisory
items.description: Define roadmaps, architecture and assessments around business priorities. Establish the capability gaps and decisions that shape your delivery plan.

items.title: Specialist talent & managed teams
items.description: Add experts across the five portfolios or a delivery pod with defined accountability. Scope the skills, work ownership and governance your programme needs.

items.title: GCC strategy & setup
items.description: Design the operating model and setup foundations for a capability centre. Define governance, tooling, talent requirements and delivery interfaces before scaling.

items.title: GCC build-operate-transfer
items.description: Build and operate the centre, then transfer it against agreed criteria. Plan scale and governance with talent, tooling and embedded engineering IP.

sections.heading: Build capability with *embedded IP*
sections.description: Talent Advisory & GCC connects the operating model, team accountability and capability transfer. Decide which artefacts transfer and which software remains licensed before the centre is built.

plays.title: Capability Centres with Embedded IP
plays.trigger: Organisations need delivery capacity with clear governance and automation.
plays.outcome: Start with a capability and ownership blueprint. Embed quality, security and engineering IP, with transfer acceptance and retained licences defined in the agreement.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Delivery Governance, Quality Engineering IP, Cyber-Safe Delivery

sections.ctaLabel: Explore Capability Centres with Embedded IP

sections.heading: Engineering IP within the *operating model*
sections.description: Use Linkfields software on its own or alongside specialist services.

items.title: Linkworks
items.description: Support a centre’s engineering work with composable applications, microservices and REST APIs. Use Linkworks for customised business applications where standard ERP or CRM functionality does not fit.

items.title: testoriumz
items.description: Equip delivery teams with test management, low-code automation, root-cause analysis and CI/CD integration. Use testoriumz to consolidate testing practices and support release evidence within the centre.

items.title: Governed delivery accelerators
items.description: Delivery Governance, Quality Engineering IP and Cyber-Safe Delivery support consistent ways of working. Select reusable IP for the centre’s scope and agree licensing and transfer boundaries.

sections.noteLabel: Software and services are separate choices
sections.note: Products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without a Linkfields services engagement. Agree deployment, data handling and integration requirements for the selected offering.

sections.heading: Choose how you scale delivery
sections.description: These are delivery models, distinct from the five commercial models. Agree ownership, governance and transfer obligations for the model you choose.

items.title: Staff augmentation
items.description: Your team manages the work; Linkfields specialists contribute within your delivery practices. Agree roles, onboarding, review responsibilities and access to tooling.
items.footText: Client-led backlog and work management; defined specialist responsibilities.

items.title: Managed teams
items.description: Linkfields runs the delivery pod against an agreed scope and outcome. Your business owner sets priorities and participates in governance and acceptance.
items.footText: Linkfields delivery accountability; client priorities and acceptance criteria.

items.title: GCC build-operate-transfer
items.description: Design and setup: agree the operating model. Build and operate: establish teams, tooling and governance. Transfer: hand over against agreed acceptance criteria.
items.footText: Agree phase owners, knowledge transfer, retained licences and the capability the client will own.

sections.note: Agree the operating model, role matrix, runbooks, knowledge transfer, handover criteria and retained software licences. South Africa HQ; India Offshore Delivery Centre; UAE, UK, USA and Australia market presence. See our [office locations](/contact-us#our-offices).
